'''Armor Unit 02''' was a [[Walker/Legends|walker]] in [[Vulture Squad]], an armored military unit of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] present in the [[Battle of the Meridian Complex]] in [[3627 BBY]].
